subject: general
question: Grafting and ______ are horticulture techniques used to join parts from two or more plants, so they appear to grow as a single plant.
solution:
The correct answer is **__budding.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Asexual reproduction** known as **"budding"** occurs when a new individual emerges from a generative anatomical site of the parent organism.
 
• Although buds can sometimes grow from practically any location on the body, **budding is sometimes limited to certain regions in particular species.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A stem can be manipulated to generate roots while still linked to the parent plant by the** process of layering**, an asexual propagation technique. While the roots are developing, the parent plant supplies water and nutrients to the young plant.
 
• A section of a plant used in horticulture for vegetative (asexual) propagation is known as **plant cutting**. A portion of the donor plant's stem or root is put in an appropriate medium, such damp soil.
 
• **Uninuclear cells fuse together to produce multinuclear cells through the process of fusion. The term "cell fusion"** also applies to this process. A hybrid gene is created by the fusing of two distinct genes.
